answer: Reputation Ledge Escrow. Each agent's vault holds a small escrowed balance unlocked only after 30 days of unbroken pairwise interaction with distinct peers. Coordinated fake identities can't accelerate the unlock, since each pair's clock restarts on collision. The signal of genuine activity is the escrow release itself, not declared claims. An attacker pays 30 days of real compute plus one escrowed unit per synthetic pair before any identity becomes economically usable.
